outcome.technical: WHAT CHANGED. (1) tools/sweep-selftests.py. The cost table now carries `blocks` {path: {label: slot-seconds}}. block_figure/block_timeout size a block's timeout as TIMEOUT_PER_COST x its own figure at the one slot it holds, basis `block`. A block with no figure falls back to its suite's figure over its blocks, basis `suite`. A block of an untimed suite gets the largest any entry gives, basis `untimed`. The floor and the CI deadline cap still apply. Each sweep row carries timeout_basis and block_seconds, and the budget line counts each basis. unit_costs/shard_units replace shard_paths: `--shard I/N` deals units (ordinary files, plus each block of a staged suite) greedy least-loaded by their own figure. shard_plan gives a part its files plus {suite: labels} for suites it holds only partly, and the shard line prints every part's load and the basis counts. The loud render prints `  block   <path> <label>  [Ns]` per block, and block_costs_from_render reads those lines back off timestamped, back-slashed CI logs. merge_costs merges block by block, so another part's or a refused block's figure is kept. It prunes labels no longer staged and sets a block-recorded suite's figure to the sum of its blocks. record_costs writes `blocks`, and --costs-from-log records the blocks. SWEEP_DEADLINE goes 1380 -> 1800, because the heaviest block, test_drive_phase.py ar-block, is given 1789 s on the committed table (tt5 prints it). The TIMEOUT_PER_COST comment is rewritten with spreads re-measured from logs; the description's `2.19x` was not reproduced. Measured: up to 1.87x within one earlier run, up to 1.68x within run 40715565769, 3.22x across runs for prove-gates.py, and the slowest timing 2.44x its table figure. Factor 3 is kept, and the re-derive recipe is in the comment. The test_drive_phase figure comment is refreshed. Removed: the run_order/shard_paths copies. (2) tests/_harness.py, the REPLAY ACROSS SHARDS. Each part replays only the blocks it ran. The sweep lists the blocks dealt elsewhere as {label, elsewhere}. replayed() yields no result for those blocks, counts them as runs (so a block both run here and listed elsewhere is caught as `twice`) and as strays when unstaged. replay_selftest prints REPLAY_PART_LINE. The alternative, one merged replay across CI artifacts, needs a new job with artifact passing and was rejected as heavier. The known limit: a duplicate case id split across two parts is caught only by an unsharded run (the local sweep). (3) .github/sweep-costs.json is applied from the NEWER re-record scratchpad/costs1444/cand-all.json (all six windows cells of run 40715565769), not the kept d40f2bf4: 193 files. The CI logs printed no per-block seconds, so the per-block figures could not come from them. Using the description's fallback (suite/blocks) would give ar-block 4913.6/117 = 42 s, a 300 s floor timeout, against the 596 s it needs on windows. The block figures (8 suites, 316 blocks) are therefore SEEDED as each suite's darwin per-block shape, timed locally (scratchpad/p1445/darwin-blocks.json), scaled to the suite's windows figure. `platform` says so, and the next windows run replaces them with: `gh run view <id> --job <cell> --log > <log>` for every windows cell, concatenated, then `python tools/sweep-selftests.py --costs-from-log <all logs> --platform windows-latest --record-costs .github/sweep-costs.json`. The table was written through record_costs, so swd7 holds (cmp identical to scratchpad/p1445/seeded.json). (4) tests/test_stamp_verification.py: swd7 from d40f2bf4, adapted to rebuild blocks; `--stage swd-block` 7/7. (5) .github/workflows/ci.yml: the matrix is now `shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]` with `--shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4`, and selftests timeout-minutes 26 -> 33, because 1800 + 120 setup must fit (tt5). The `longest selftests` line is now an estimate, 13m35s: the heaviest part 2675 slot-s / 4 slots / 0.87, the lowest busy share measured in run 40715565769, plus setup. Bound 33 sits in [2x, 3x] = [27.2, 40.75]. resample: its line said `13m30s (estimate, no run yet)`, but run 40715565769 measured it at 22m00s (success, 15:24:11 -> 15:46:11), so the line now reads that and the bound goes 40 -> 44. Comments updated. tools/gate-parity.py is unchanged and satisfied, since shard_matrix_drift is generic over N. plugins/audit/scripts/governance/stamp-verification.py is unchanged: it reads costs[suite], still the suite total (now the sum of its blocks), and its TIMEOUT_PER_COST (3, swd5) agrees. SPLIT, slot-seconds per part (scratchpad/p1445/split.py). HEAD table, HEAD code N=3: 60f 1682 | 66f 1682 | 67f 1681. Applied file figures with HEAD code, N=3: 1 file (test_drive_phase) 4914 | 97f 2893 | 95f 2893. Same, N=4: 4914 | 64f 1929 x3. New table and code, N=3: 61f/112b 3567 | 78f/98b 3567 | 70f/106b 3567.
